text: Can CLSS prefix reachable-set compression + channel-deletion lifting + seam surgery strictly improve any live (size, depth) entry on Dobbelaere sorting_networks_extended.html for 13 <= n <= 32?
Exhaustive baseline audit of sorting_networks_extended.html and sorting_networks_avgswaps.html + 1-minimality scan across n=13..32
Channel-deletion projections from n+1/n+2 networks + prefix reachable-set compression R_k + exact SAT/CP-SAT/search suffix synthesis
CLSS seam surgery (k-for-(k-1) comparator window replacement, suffix MCMC/tabu/SAT polish on R_k, and critical-path depth reduction) on live n=17..32 networks

All 122 sorting networks in sorting_networks_extended.html (n=2..64) and all 63 in sorting_networks_avgswaps.html (n=2..64) have exact matching size and greedy ASAP depth, standard orientation 0<=i<j<n, and exact 0-1 sorting validity (62/62 extended and 31/31 avgswaps for n=2..32; 52/60 extended and 25/32 avgswaps for n=33..64 within 15M DAG states); avgswaps contains 55 distinct comparator lists vs extended, but 0/63 entries are undominated by extended.

Exhaustive 1-minimality scan across all published networks for n=13..32 in sorting_networks_extended.html (4,462 single-comparator removals) and sorting_networks_avgswaps.html (2,246 single-comparator removals) finds 0 redundant comparators; every single published network is strictly 1-minimal.

All 1-, 2-, and 3-wire extreme channel deletions c in {0, n-1} from n=14..36 down to n=13..32 across extended and avgswaps tables followed by exact iterative 1-minimal pruning (pruning up to 9 redundant comparators per reduced network, 385 total pruned comparators) reproduce exact Pareto ties on n=14,15,28,29,30 (e.g. N32L185D14 -2 wires -1 pruned -> N30 (172,14); N31L180D14 -1 wire -2 pruned -> N30 (172,14)) but yield 0 strictly undominated (size, depth) pairs.

Interior channel deletion (0 < c < n-1) via Knuth +/-infinity trajectory tracing (260 exact valid sorters for n=14..33) and adjacent-layer comparator contraction (a,c)+(c,b)->(a,b) (8 exact valid sorters for n=14..33) followed by exact 1-minimal pruning reproduces Pareto ties on n=14 (51,10) and (52,9) but yields 0 undominated pairs.

Cross-network prefix-suffix splicing A[:lA] + B[lB:] across extended, avgswaps, and wire-reversed duals (i,j)->(n-1-j,n-1-i) for n=13..32 yields 958 valid sorting splices and 52 single-comparator seam prunings (e.g. ext_N17L72D11[:10]+ext_N17L74D10_rev[9:] (73,11)->(72,11), ext_N25L131D13[:12]+ext_N25L130D15[14:] (132,13)->(131,13)), but simultaneous double-drops leave 1 unsorted state and 0 splices beat the Pareto frontier.

Mode A critical-path ASAP depth compression (d -> d-1 at fixed size s and Pareto size gaps s+delta) across 25 extended and avgswaps runs for n=19..29 using stepwise critical-path compression seeding + 1-opt polish + multithreaded bit-parallel R_k MCMC/tabu reaches 3 unsorted states on N24 (121,12), 4 unsorted on N25 (130,14), and 5 unsorted on N21 (99,14) and N23 (114,13), but 0 runs reach unsorted=0.

Mode B suffix size reduction (s -> s-1 at depth d <= d_orig) across 59 extended and avgswaps runs for n=17..32 (k=3,4,5,6 reachable sets R_k) with 1-deletion + 2-for-1 window seeding, reflection-symmetric pair moves, and MCMC/tabu reaches unsorted=1 (score=1025) on 6 networks (N17L74D10, N29L166D14, ext/avg N29L164D15, N31L180D14, N32L185D14) and unsorted=2 on 9 networks (including 4->2 on N17L72D11 and N28L155D14, 3->2 on N26L141D13 and avg_N31L180D14), but 0 runs reach unsorted=0.

Exact defect-trajectory tree pruning Delta(suf,v0)->Fix(v1) on unsorted=1 suffixes (N17L74D10, N29L166D14, N31L180D14, N32L185D14) proves that the unique failing vector v0 is swapped by only 2-3 comparators across the entire suffix and has 1 active inversion over the final 40+ comparators; every depth-feasible 1-opt or 2-opt edit that sorts v0 induces >=1 collateral unsorted vector v1 in R_k.

Exact C branch-and-bound suffix synthesis (suffix_synth.c) from prefix reachable sets U_k at k in {d-3, d-2, d-1} across all n=17..32 networks in extended and avgswaps proves 0 suffixes of size <= |S_orig|-1 or depth <= d_orig-1 exist when keeping prefix L_1..L_k fixed

Multi-wire top/bottom channel-deletion projections (channel_del_scan.c) + check_sn_bits --check-1minimal pruning across n=14..32 reproduce exact Pareto frontier entries (e.g. N32(185,14)->N30(172,14) via 1 redundant comparator removal, N31(180,14)->N29(166,14)) but yield 0 strictly undominated (size, depth) pairs

Sliding cross-layer window re-synthesis (cross_layer_window.c) and unequal-split prefix + Batcher/Van Voorhis merge seam pruning across n=17..32 cannot reduce size or depth below live SorterHunter/Wang25 bounds because middle layers have full channel occupancy and zero slack on the critical DAG path

Joint prefix-layer (layers 2..4) perturbation + CaDiCaL/CP-SAT exact suffix synthesis on the 6 unsorted=1 size targets (N17L74D10, N29L166D14, N29L164D15, N31L180D14, N32L185D14) and 3 unsorted=3..4 depth targets (N24(121,12), N25(130,14), N21(99,14))
